tier_descriptions.D: Bottom 20% (12 candidates) — Likely not a fit

interview_answer: Instead of binary shortlisted/rejected, I built a continuous ranking system. All 64 candidates get a composite score (0-100) based on embedding similarity (25%), HR feature matching (35%), ML model (25%), and semantic skill matching (15%). HR sees candidates ranked with tiers A/B/C/D and can pick the top 10 for interviews. This eliminates the 'hard cutoff' problem.
